`_from_xarray` now unconditionally attempts to unflatten tuple-valued snapshot indexes whenever the component has a network, without checking semantics or `optimization.model_snapshot_index`. For an array with a flat object index of `(period, timestep)` tuples and matching auxiliary coordinates, this changes that index into a MultiIndex before conversion to pandas; base_commit leaves it flat. Thus the same input can produce a different result even under legacy semantics with the default or `"multiindex"` option.
